title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Advance Terms Against Unpriced Bushels
content:
Some marketing programmes under Grain Marketing Contracts open an advance against bushels the member is carrying unpriced. Whether the facility is open at all, what share of market value it will advance and what interest an outstanding advance carries are catalogue terms of the programme.

| Programme | Advance facility open | Share of market value advanced (percent) | Interest on an outstanding advance (annual percentage rate) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | No | 0.0 | 0.00 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | No | 0.0 | 0.00 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | Yes | 60.0 | 8.25 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | Yes | 65.0 | 8.25 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | Yes | 70.0 | 7.90 |
| Minimum Price Contract | Yes | 60.0 | 8.75 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | Yes | 55.0 | 9.25 |

Where the facility is not open the share and the interest rate are nil, and no advance is drawn on that programme whatever the bushels standing unpriced.

The largest share in the catalogue is the 70.0 percent carried by the Delayed Price Agreement, at the lowest rate of 7.90; the Managed Accumulator Program carries the smallest share at 55.0 percent and the highest rate at 9.25.
